title: Area 51 sensor program for detecting UFOs, as told in The Age of Disclosure

tellings.quote:
publicly in the age of disclosure was
like at Area 51, we had some sensor
program. when we were looking for for
UFOs

plain: There was a sensor programme at Area 51, the secret military test site in Nevada, that was used to look for UFOs. Michels says this was said publicly in The Age of Disclosure, a documentary about government UFO secrecy, though in this telling he does not say who said it. If true, it would mean the government was watching for these objects with its own instruments.
